target.statement: XGBoost model predicting county-level overdose SMR achieves R2 = 0.457 (±0.049) under 5-fold CV (best of four models)
target.dataset: Merged 2022 county-level data: CDC WONDER (975 non-suppressed counties), CDC SVI, CDC PLACES, HRSA AHRF

compute.basis: All four federal datasets are public but must be manually downloaded and merged by FIPS; the SMR outcome must be reconstructed from WONDER counts/population, and the exact 25-feature set, median imputation, and XGBoost hyperparameters are not specified, so an agent must rebuild the pipeline from scratch; the model itself is tiny (975 rows) and trains in seconds on CPU.

blockers: No code or configs released; feature construction and hyperparameters must be reverse-engineered
CDC WONDER suppression handling and SMR reference rate must be re-derived
AHRF/PLACES/SVI files require manual download and FIPS harmonization
Exact R2 (±0.049) unlikely to match without the authors' precise preprocessing
title: Social Determinants of Health and Fentanyl Overdose Mortality Across US Counties: An XGBoost and SHAP Analysis Identifying Silent Risk Counties and Treatment Deserts
